definitions.ask: Where should `o`/`O` on a task inside a status group open the new Ready task?
definitions.why: A new Ready task must never be born inside Done & Canceled or Blocked

choices.label: At the end of the section's intake, with a <C-o> jump back to the origin
Right below the block; the settle at scaffold commit then moves it to intake

definitions.ask: When a settle moves the task under the cursor, should the cursor stay put?
definitions.why: Research recommendation; keeps rapid editing in place and the viewport still

choices.label: Cursor stays on its line; a <C-o> jump entry points at the moved task
Cursor follows the task into its group; <C-o> returns to where it was
